title: The value of the 'name' field is required to be a string.
summary: Try converting the value to be a string.
message_templates: The value of the 'name' field is required to be a string.

title: Function expressions can't be named.
summary: Try removing the name, or moving the function expression to a function declaration statement.

title: Function types can't be named.
summary: Try replacing the name with the keyword 'Function'.

title: Named parameters must be enclosed in curly braces ('{' and '}').
summary: Try surrounding the named parameters in curly braces.
message_templates: Named parameters must be enclosed in curly braces ('{' and '}').

title: Native clause can only be used in the SDK and code that is loaded through native extensions.
message_templates: Native clause can only be used in the SDK and code that is loaded through native extensions.

title: Native clause in this form is deprecated.
summary: Try removing this native clause and adding @native() or @native('native-name') before the declaration.
message_templates: Native clause in this form is deprecated.

title: '…' is an unsupported type for native fields. Native fields only support pointers, arrays or numeric and compound types.
summary: Try changing the type in the `@Native` annotation to a numeric FFI type, a pointer, array, or a compound class.
message_templates: '{}' is an unsupported type for native fields. Native fields only support pointers, arrays or numeric and compound types.

title: The native type of this field could not be inferred and must be specified in the annotation.
summary: Try adding a type parameter extending `NativeType` to the `@Native` annotation.
message_templates: The native type of this field could not be inferred and must be specified in the annotation.

title: Native fields must be static.
summary: Try adding the modifier 'static' to this field.

title: Native functions can only be declared in the SDK and code that is loaded through native extensions.
message_templates: Native functions can only be declared in the SDK and code that is loaded through native extensions.

title: The native type of this function couldn't be inferred so it must be specified in the annotation.
summary: Try adding a type parameter extending `NativeType` to the `@Native` annotation.
message_templates: The native type of this function couldn't be inferred so it must be specified in the annotation.
